            current date.
          type: string
          format: date

            Optional. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'

            4-digit value valid for the owner's city per the fixed region table

                the last two digits of the registrationDate year.

              readOnly: true

              title: Household ID
              description: >-

                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner
                is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and another owner already

              readOnly: true

              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned when the owner is
                created and never changes afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

                sharing an existing owner's last name and postcode with a

              type: boolean

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

                created. Starts at 1; add 1 when an email address is present; add
                1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0). Capped at
                3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:

                birthDate is known.
              type: string
              enum:

                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true

    ProblemDetail:

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized into E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped,
            an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 40
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The e-mail address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address. The value is stored and
            returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's
            current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be a
            4-digit value valid for the owner's city per the fixed region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they knowingly share a
            household). Write-only; it is never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A stable customer code assigned when the owner is created,
                formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three
                letters of city, a hyphen, the upper-cased first three letters
                of lastName, a hyphen, and a 4-digit zero-padded per-city
                sequence equal to one more than the number of owners already in
                that city at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted
                '<customerCode>-M<YY>': the customer code, the literal '-M', and
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who knowingly share a
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner
                is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and another owner already
                lives at that address; every owner in the household is given the
                same value. Absent for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'e3b0c442-98fc-3c14-9afb-4c8996fb9242'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned when the owner is
                created and never changes afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created
                sharing an existing owner's last name and postcode with a
                different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the existing owner this one softly matches on last name
                and postcode (with a different telephone). Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned when the owner is
                created. Starts at 1; add 1 when an email address is present; add
                1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0). Capped at
                3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by
                registration date) at the time this owner was created; otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed as
                normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId
                (an absent email or householdId contributes an empty segment). A
                create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when the whole identity
                key equals that of an existing owner.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                owner's registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when
                18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no
                birthDate is known.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented `telephoneDisplay` — the stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans — while keeping `telephone` as raw E.164.

**Changes:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added a read-only `telephoneDisplay` property to the `Owner` schema (the DTO is generated from this spec at build time).

2. **`TelephoneNormalizer.java`** — Added `toDisplay(String)`, which splits the E.164 number into its country code (using the existing known-country-code table) and national digits, then joins the country code and the national digits grouped in threes with spaces, e.g. `+61412345678` → `+61 412 345 678`. I refactored the country-code matching into a shared `matchLongestCountryCode` helper reused by the existing validation logic. Non-E.164 values are returned unchanged; unknown country codes group the full number.

3. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — Added a `telephoneDisplay(owner)` mapping that delegates to `TelephoneNormalizer.toDisplay(owner.getTelephone())`.

The acceptance test `coreFormatsTelephoneDisplay` (asserting `telephone` = `+61412345678` and `telephoneDisplay` = `+61 412 345 678`) passes, and the full suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`, Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0).
